records.title: Coinbase Wrapped Assets — cbXRP deposit and automatic unwrap process
records.summary: Coinbase states wrapped assets are backed 1:1 by the corresponding native asset held in Coinbase custody. cbXRP is supported on Base. When cbXRP is deposited to a Coinbase Exchange account, it is automatically unwrapped and credited to the user's native XRP balance.
records.limitations: This proves a redemption mechanism, not that any identified Morpho liquidator used it or sold the resulting XRP.

records.title: Base Morpho liquidator activity — address 0x4c0f…19f4
records.summary: Provider attributes 431 Morpho liquidations across 111 Base transactions to this address, including 132 cbXRP/USDC liquidations with $1,074,780 USDC debt repaid and $136,240 protocol bonus. Displayed activity ends 2026-10-08T17:27Z. It reports -$2.54 realized take across 45 measured transactions, but does not establish cbXRP disposition for each event.
records.limitations: Third-party index, one liquidator address, not total market activity. Realized-take scope is unclear and does not prove collateral was sold or retained.

records.title: Morpho cbXRP/USDC liquidation — transaction 0x24be…f72
records.summary: One event (log 574) in a 30-liquidation Base Morpho transaction repaid 829.4 USDC of borrower 0x749b…20cf and seized 701.6 cbXRP, with a $105.09 protocol bonus. Liquidator retained proceeds are explicitly not measured.
records.limitations: 701.6 cbXRP is one event, not the batch total. Subsequent swap, hold, Coinbase deposit, unwrap or native XRP sale was not traced.

records.title: Clearstar USDC vault allocation to cbXRP/USDC 62.5% LLTV market
records.summary: Morpho Clearstar USDC vault displays $410.85K USDC allocated to cbXRP 62.5% LLTV, $6.47M underlying market liquidity, 90.07% utilization and 5.86% APY. A visible allocator transaction on 2026-10-10 added 14,000.5 USDC to that market.
records.limitations: One curator's vault position, not total market supply or Coinbase loan originations. Vault allocation and underlying market liquidity are distinct.

records.title: Separate cbXRP/USDC Morpho market with 77% LLTV
records.summary: A distinct Base cbXRP/USDC market has 77% LLTV. The captured page displays $456.95K total supply, $394.46K borrowed, $62.65K available, 86.29% utilization, 7.41% liquidation penalty and 4.94% seven-day borrow rate.
records.limitations: Point-in-time interface snapshot; it does not establish Coinbase product routing or total cbXRP-backed borrowing.

records.title: Morpho Blue public REST API and historical market-data capabilities
records.summary: Morpho documents public GET endpoints for Blue market listings, immutable parameters, current market state, APY averages, user positions and historical data. Cross-market aggregate overviews and some aggregate collateral metrics are not available through public REST endpoints.
records.limitations: API endpoints were not called in this run. Pagination, rate limits, historical interval coverage and timestamp semantics require testing.
